invariants: Browsing and listing creation remain free across every silo.
B2B participation has no mandatory platform, listing, or cross-silo fee.
Human-to-human marketplace transactions have a 0 basis-point platform fee.
The 2% fee applies only to machine-to-machine x402 transactions after the settlement verifier is implemented and enabled.
Paid visibility is a separate optional offer and is disabled by default.
A Promoted or Sponsored badge may render only when a trusted server response explicitly returns is_promoted=true.
No checkout is enabled solely by a catalogue field or the presence of a payment URL.
A product remains non-checkoutable until payment verification and its actual fulfillment path have been independently verified.
